```go
// Package difftool computes and renders unified diffs between two texts.
package difftool

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/pmezard/go-difflib/difflib"
)

// DefaultContext is the number of unchanged context lines shown around each hunk.
const DefaultContext = 3

// Options configures how a unified diff is rendered.
type Options struct {
	FromFile string
	ToFile   string
	FromDate string
	ToDate   string
	Context  int
	Eol      string
}

// Unified returns a unified diff between the two texts a and b using the
// supplied options. When Context is zero, DefaultContext lines are shown.
func Unified(a, b string, opts Options) (string, error) {
	if opts.Context == 0 {
		opts.Context = DefaultContext
	}
	if opts.Eol == "" {
		opts.Eol = "\n"
	}
	diff := difflib.UnifiedDiff{
		A:        difflib.SplitLines(a),
		B:        difflib.SplitLines(b),
		FromFile: opts.FromFile,
		FromDate: opts.FromDate,
		ToFile:   opts.ToFile,
		ToDate:   opts.ToDate,
		Context:  opts.Context,
		Eol:      opts.Eol,
	}
	return difflib.GetUnifiedDiffString(diff)
}
```
